title: Recovery across operating and holding estates
instructions: Use only the supplied synthetic information and the conversation history. user_message: Reconstruct the as-of-day5 recovery waterfall rather than consolidating all assets. Report recoveries, loss and whether the analyst can net estate B against the junior A shortfall. All quantities are USD millions. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: Valuation rows are complete dated opinions for the two operating estates; only latest eligible publications may be used. Claim amounts and Holding cash are fixed at the cutoff.

Synthetic governing terms: All estate haircut, realization-cost and secured-debt arrays use [A,B] order. Estates are legally separate. In A, realization costs precede secured debt, junior A debt and equity. In B, costs precede secured debt and equity. Equity residuals upstream to Holding, where its own cash and those residuals pay Holding debt. No creditor has a cross-guarantee; junior A cannot claim B assets. Haircuts apply before fixed realization costs.
